tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards. Never put body text straight on it without a card unless it is a heading or lede.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, tables, the top bar. The main reading ground.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Table headers, flat cards, code and output blocks, hover fills.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Neutral pill fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, tables and dividers.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Input and button borders, chart baselines. 3:1+ on surface and surface-2 in both themes, so control edges read without color.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on page, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, labels, chart labels. On surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: help text, captions, table headers, kickers. On page, surface and surface-2 (4.5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a filled accent or signal button. White in light, deep ink in dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The active signal color. Each tool page rebinds it to its sig-<tool> token; the hub uses this Lift-blue default. Primary buttons, active tab, links, key figures.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text: example banner, info pills, meter track.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Status: success text and icon. Always with a word and the check glyph.

tokens.name: good-wash
tokens.usage: Status: success pill and callout fill.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status: warning text. Always with a word and the ! glyph.

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Status: warning pill and callout fill.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Status: failure or destructive text. Always with a word and the x glyph.

tokens.name: bad-wash
tokens.usage: Status: failure pill and callout fill.

tokens.name: bar-muted
tokens.usage: Comparison or baseline bars in charts (the "before" or control series). Never text.

tokens.name: hl-risk
tokens.usage: Highlight behind risk-avoidance phrases in the copy analyzer.

tokens.name: hl-upside
tokens.usage: Highlight behind upside phrases in the copy analyzer.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid. Follows the tool signal.

tokens.name: sig-launch-lift
tokens.usage: Lift blue: the signal for the launch-lift tool. Blue reads as signal and go-live. It's the launch-day color. Bound to accent on that page. Text-safe on surface and its wash (5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: sig-launch-lift-wash
tokens.usage: Tint for Lift blue: banners and info pills on the launch-lift page.

tokens.name: sig-adoption-campaign
tokens.usage: Adoption green: the signal for the adoption-campaign tool. Green for growth and habit: users moving from never-tried to active. Bound to accent on that page. Text-safe on surface and its wash (5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: sig-adoption-campaign-wash
tokens.usage: Tint for Adoption green: banners and info pills on the adoption-campaign page.

tokens.name: sig-positioning-lab
tokens.usage: Variant magenta: the signal for the positioning-lab tool. A test color. Magenta stays clear of status colors, so a variant never looks like a warning. Bound to accent on that page. Text-safe on surface and its wash (5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: sig-positioning-lab-wash
tokens.usage: Tint for Variant magenta: banners and info pills on the positioning-lab page.

tokens.name: sig-inbound-agent
tokens.usage: Agent teal: the signal for the inbound-agent tool. Machine-cool teal for the automated workflow the GTME owns. Bound to accent on that page. Text-safe on surface and its wash (5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: sig-inbound-agent-wash
tokens.usage: Tint for Agent teal: banners and info pills on the inbound-agent page.

tokens.name: sig-agent-roi
tokens.usage: Ledger amber: the signal for the agent-roi tool. The color of money and ledgers: this tool is a business case. Bound to accent on that page. Text-safe on surface and its wash (5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: sig-agent-roi-wash
tokens.usage: Tint for Ledger amber: banners and info pills on the agent-roi page.

tokens.name: sig-win-room
tokens.usage: Bake-off orange: the signal for the win-room tool. Competitive heat. Orange signals pressure without reading as a loss. Bound to accent on that page. Text-safe on surface and its wash (5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: sig-win-room-wash
tokens.usage: Tint for Bake-off orange: banners and info pills on the win-room page.

tokens.name: sig-narrative-library
tokens.usage: Narrative violet: the signal for the narrative-library tool. Editorial violet for the approved messaging library. Bound to accent on that page. Text-safe on surface and its wash (5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: sig-narrative-library-wash
tokens.usage: Tint for Narrative violet: banners and info pills on the narrative-library page.

tokens.name: sig-segment-sizer
tokens.usage: Cohort olive: the signal for the segment-sizer tool. Earthy olive for markets, populations and territory. Bound to accent on that page. Text-safe on surface and its wash (5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: sig-segment-sizer-wash
tokens.usage: Tint for Cohort olive: banners and info pills on the segment-sizer page.

tokens.name: sig-risk-messaging
tokens.usage: Risk red: the signal for the risk-messaging tool. Red names the risk buyers are trying to avoid. It's the subject of the tool. Bound to accent on that page. Text-safe on surface and its wash (5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: sig-risk-messaging-wash
tokens.usage: Tint for Risk red: banners and info pills on the risk-messaging page.

tokens.name: sig-fast-five
tokens.usage: Interview cyan: the signal for the fast-five tool. Clear cyan for listening and research. Bound to accent on that page. Text-safe on surface and its wash (5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: sig-fast-five-wash
tokens.usage: Tint for Interview cyan: banners and info pills on the fast-five page.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-hero
styles.sample: Ten results from the brief, rebuilt as tools you can run
styles.usage: Hub hero only. Archivo at 112% width.

styles.name: readout-figure
styles.usage: The brief outcome in the tool header, in accent.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Model what an agent really costs to run per lead.
styles.usage: One sentence under the tool name, ink-2.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every lead gets a route plus the exact reasons why.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Use your provider's current list price.
styles.usage: Help text and stat subtitles, ink-3.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: Readout tiles. Proportional digits are fine here; tables use tabular.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, table headers (11px), the tool number chip.

styles.name: cell-number
styles.usage: Numeric table cells and number inputs, tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Stacked fields inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards; page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page top padding; hero spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hub section breaks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, tooltips, menu items, the tool number chip.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, banners, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, meters, toast.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Rare. Menus and dialogs carry their own heavier shadow; cards use a hairline, not a shadow.
